title: NanoBanana 2 Lite joins the image models
summary:
Two new models landed alongside Quest status tools, community model management, and a mobile authorization fix.

Added paid-only `nanobanana-2-lite` for image generation and editing with up to 14 reference images. Its route defaults to 1K output.

Added paid-only `claude-sonnet-5` with a 1M-token context, image input, tool calls, and adaptive thinking.

Added a read-only Quest status API and Polli Quest commands. Invite-only community model management moved to `/account/my-models` for dashboard and API use, with a matching Polli command. Public model IDs now use `{username}/{model-id}`, while older IDs remain aliases. Three more accounts became eligible to register models, and dashboard banners now point people to Quests and the community models alpha.

highlights.title: NanoBanana 2 Lite
highlights.text: Generate or edit images with `nanobanana-2-lite`, using up to 14 reference images. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana-2-lite).

highlights.title: Claude Sonnet 5
highlights.text: Use `claude-sonnet-5` for text and image input, tool calls, adaptive thinking, and a 1M-token context. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-sonnet-5).

highlights.title: Check Quest status
highlights.text: Read your completed Quests and earned rewards through `GET /account/quests`, or check them with `polli quests` and `polli quests mine`. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Manage your models
highlights.text: Eligible community model owners can list, register, update, test, and remove models through `/account/my-models` or `polli my-models`. Public model IDs now use `{username}/{model-id}`; older IDs remain aliases. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
